name: std::strstream::pcount
intro: Returns the number of characters that were output in the put area of the associated std::strstreambuf. Effectively calls rdbuf()->pcount().

sections.title: Return value
sections.text: The number of characters in the put area, or zero if nothing was output.

examples.output:
The size of the output is 11 and it holds "Test: 1.23"
